title: PlanInfoResponse
description: Detailed information about the current license plan.

planName.description: The name of the current plan.

planCode.description: The unique code for the current plan.

planStatus.description: The current status of the plan (e.g., Active, Trial, Expired).

expiryDate.description: The expiry date of the current plan represented as milliseconds since Unix epoch.

billingCycle.description: The billing cycle for the plan (e.g., Monthly, Annual).

storePlanId.description: The ID of the plan in the billing/store system.

storeProfileId.description: The ID of the profile in the billing/store system.

previousPlanCode.description: The code of the previous plan, if applicable.
